questions.stem: Which unit is used to measure the length of a classroom?
questions.solution: The metre is the standard unit for measuring lengths of rooms or classrooms because it is appropriately sized for such dimensions. A kilometre is far too large, used for much greater distances, while millimetres and centimetres are too small for measuring spaces of that scale. Therefore, the correct option is 'Metre'.

hi.stem: कक्षा की लंबाई मापने के लिए कौन सा इकाई प्रयोग किया जाता है?
hi.solution: मीटर कक्षाओं या कक्षा की लंबाई मापने के लिए मानक इकाई है क्योंकि यह ऐसे आयामों के लिए उपयुक्त आकार की होती है। किलोमीटर बहुत बड़ा होता है, जो बहुत बड़ी दूरियों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जबकि मिलीमीटर और सेंटीमीटर इस पैमाने के स्थानों के लिए बहुत छोटे होते हैं। इसलिए सही विकल्प 'मीटर' है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Indian educational terminology.

mr.stem: एका शाळेच्या खोलीच्या लांबीचे मोजण्यास कोणते एकक वापरले जाते?
mr.solution: मीटर हे खोली किंवा शाळेच्या लांबीच्या मोजण्यासाठी मानक एकक आहे कारण ते अशा अंतरांसाठी योग्य आकाराचे आहे. किलोमीटर खूप जास्त मोठे आहे, जे खूप मोठ्या अंतरांसाठी वापरले जाते, तर मिलीमीटर आणि सेंटीमीटर अशा अंतरांच्या मोजण्यासाठी खूप लहान आहेत. म्हणून, योग्य पर्याय 'मीटर' आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for units of measurement.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of an infrared thermometer?
choices: To measure the temperature of a liquid
To measure body temperature by direct contact
To measure temperature from a distance without touching
To measure the temperature of the sun
questions.solution: An infrared thermometer measures temperature from a distance without touching the object, which is useful for quick and non-contact readings. Measuring a liquid's temperature, body temperature by direct contact, or the sun's temperature does not align with how infrared thermometers function, as they rely on detecting heat radiation.

hi.stem: अंतर-दृश्य तापमापी का उद्देश्य क्या है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to measure the length of a pencil?
questions.solution: A ruler is used to measure the length of a pencil because it is designed for short, straight measurements. A measuring tape is better suited for longer distances, a protractor measures angles, and a balance scale measures mass or weight.

questions.stem: If a laboratory thermometer has a range from 0°C to 100°C and there are 10 divisions between each 10°C mark, what is the value of each small division?
questions.solution: The thermometer has a range of 100°C, with 10 divisions between each 10°C mark. This means each small division represents 1°C. The correct answer is 1°C because 10°C divided by 10 divisions equals 1°C per division. The other options do not match this calculation.

hi.stem: यदि एक प्रयोगशाला थर्मामीटर की सीमा 0°C से 100°C तक है और प्रत्येक 10°C चिह्न के बीच 10 विभाजन हैं, तो प्रत्येक छोटे विभाजन का मान क्या है?
hi.solution: थर्मामीटर की सीमा 100°C है, जिसमें प्रत्येक 10°C चिह्न के बीच 10 विभाजन हैं। इसका अर्थ है कि प्रत्येक छोटा विभाजन 1°C के बराबर होता है। सही उत्तर 1°C है क्योंकि 10°C को 10 विभाजन में विभाजित करने पर प्रति विभाजन 1°C प्राप्त होता है। अन्य विकल्प इस गणना के अनुरूप नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for a science textbook.

mr.stem: जर एखाद्या प्रयोगशाळा थर्मॉमीटरचा श्रेणी 0°C ते 100°C असेल आणि प्रत्येक 10°C च्या चिन्हात 10 विभाग असतील, तर प्रत्येक लहान विभागाची किंमत किती असेल?
mr.solution: थर्मॉमीटरचा श्रेणी 100°C असून प्रत्येक 10°C च्या चिन्हात 10 विभाग असतात. ह्यामुळे प्रत्येक लहान विभाग 1°C ला बरोबर असतो. योग्य उत्तर 1°C असेल कारण 10°C ला 10 विभागांनी भागल्यास प्रत्येक विभागाला 1°C ची किंमत येते. इतर उत्तरे ह्या गणनेशी जुळत नाहीत.

questions.stem: What should be done to measure the temperature of a leaf on a tree?
choices: Place the thermometer in the armpit
Ensure the bulb touches the leaf
questions.solution: To accurately measure the temperature of a leaf, the bulb of the thermometer must directly touch the leaf to ensure proper heat transfer and an accurate reading. Holding the thermometer vertically or placing it in the armpit is not relevant to measuring a leaf's temperature. Using a digital thermometer is not inherently correct unless the bulb is in contact with the leaf.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about a clinical thermometer?
choices: It can measure temperatures up to 110°C
It is used to measure the temperature of boiling liquids
It is used to measure body temperature
questions.solution: A clinical thermometer is specifically designed to measure body temperature, which is its primary use. It has a limited range, typically between 35°C and 42°C, making it unsuitable for measuring higher temperatures like those of boiling liquids. The other options are incorrect because they either describe different types of thermometers or misrepresent the accuracy and purpose of a clinical thermometer.
